{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id entries and keep only the highest sample_seq for each patient
df = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Check for sentinel values (e.g., -999) that might indicate missing or invalid data
sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()

# Remove rows with sentinel values if any
if sentinel_count > 0:
    df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Recalculate mean baseline biomarker value
mean_biomarker = df['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

mean_biomarker"}
